label: Synthetic actor parody ensemble and Rod Serling narration

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

library_reference: prosjektbibliotek/OFFENTLIG_INVENTAR.md entry for debpalash/VoiceStudio. Existing VoiceStudio 0.5.6 and already installed OmniVoice/faster-whisper-small reused. No new model or service installed.
source_excerpt_policy: One conditioning_text per actor, at most 25 source words, only in profiles.json. Full original source ASR and recordings remain outside Git.
rights: Public source access does not establish permission to clone or distribute the voice. No consent, endorsement or independently verified source licence is asserted. The Serling archive uploader public-domain label is unverified.

postprocessing.gain: One constant gain per clip seeks -20 dBFS nonsilent RMS and caps decoded peak at -2 dBFS. No time stretching or pitch shift.

scope.ensemble: 100 existing actor speech clips: Stanton18, Bacall49 including phone/CB/replies, Stack19, Lynch13, Price1 reused at two tape sites. Player lines/asides excluded.
scope.serling: 1402 existing prose/chapter-field/fragment clips including complete number and identifier banks. Every closed/recap/next/title branch is included; clocks use the shared complete numeric resolver. Existing Kinski corpus remains untouched.

segmentation: Exact normalized text first, then complete static fragments, number/clock and strict identifier composition. Runtime wording and IDs are unchanged by explicit pronunciation requests. Unknown tokens fail availability rather than skip words.
pronunciation_overrides: generate.py documents same-value letter names, initials, elevation, pauses, strict IDs and signed values. Targeted corrections are pinned by request-overrides.json with separate cache identities and corrections.json evidence.

verification.asr_ensemble: asr.json: every one of 100 actor clips; context-asr.json and word-diagnostics.json preserve ambiguous short-line checks
verification.asr_serling: serling/asr.json: all chapter fields plus stratified long/prose sources and actual no-gap runtime compositions covering clock/negative numbers/identifiers and every number/identifier lexeme
verification.asr_model: Systran/faster-whisper-small, already installed, accurate mode, refine false; automatic word check is not human listening
verification.interpretation: PASS is the technical file/PCM/hash/provenance check with all automatic word results reviewed. It is not exact-word listening approval. Listed unresolved word, identifier and clock ambiguities remain.

rejected_carrier_trial.decision: A bounded carrier-word method did not establish sufficiently clean final lexemes. Carrier-free selected takes remain; no carrier words or trims are in runtime.

coverage_addendum.source: src/story/caliche.ts add(...,examine) argument four, all finite branches
coverage_addendum.word_check: Every added town-examine clip is checked, in addition to the recomputed current stratified set and preserved valid ASR history.
